description:
Research the browser compatibility and specification status of 5 modern CSS features: (1) Container Queries, (2) :has() pseudo-class, (3) Subgrid, (4) color-mix() function, and (5) CSS Nesting. Use MDN Web Docs (developer.mozilla.org), Can I Use (caniuse.com), and W3C specifications (w3.org or drafts.csswg.org) as your sources. 

Deliverables:
1. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'CSS Compatibility Research' containing at least 5 bookmarks from these sources.
2. Create a JSON report at '~/Documents/css_compatibility_report.json' with the structure shown below, filling in the first supported version for Chrome, Firefox, and Safari, the specification status (e.g., 'Working Draft', 'CR'), and a recommendation ('safe to use', 'use with fallback', etc.).

JSON Structure:
{
  "container_queries": { "spec_status": "...", "chrome_version": "...", "firefox_version": "...", "safari_version": "...", "recommendation": "..." },
  "has_selector": { ... },
  "subgrid": { ... },
  "color_mix": { ... },
  "css_nesting": { ... }
}
